name: scheduler-report
description: Report the outcome of a scheduled job run. Writes a summary and optional structured context to the job's run record so the principal and agents can review what happened on the last execution. This records the job run only and does not close a linked task — call task-complete or task-update for that. When called from a scheduled run, job_id is optional — the runtime derives it from the conversation. Outside a scheduled run, pass job_id explicitly.

inputs.job_id: string? (optional inside a scheduled run — derived from conversation; required outside one)
